	Strong commercial and cost governance skills.

	Excellent contract strategy and administration capabilities.
	Experience in claims management and dispute resolution.
	Proficiency in procurement and commercial advisory.

	Health and wellbeing support.

Commercial Operations Manager Job at WTS Energy




        
    

        
        WTS Energy - Our client is recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Commercial Operations Manager

Job Location: Nigeria
Reports to: General Manager, Commercial Operations

Job Summary
     

            
    




	Our client is seeking a Commercial Operations Manager to provide strategic leadership of its Commercial function, optimizing value and cost, ensuring contractual and regulatory compliance, and supporting sustainable business growth.
	This role involves end-to-end commercial leadership across oil & gas and infrastructure projects, contract and claim management, and cross-functional stakeholder engagement. The successful candidate will safeguard organizational profitability while driving commercial excellence.


Key Roles & Responsibilities
Cost and Commercial Leadership:


	Provide end-to-end commercial leadership across oil & gas and Infra projects, including marginal field development, brownfield modifications, and EPC/EPCM scopes.
	Identify new commercial opportunities, develop business cases, and secure approvals for intercompany billing.
	Advise management on commercial strategy & modelling to maximise value and manage delivery risk
	Drive lifecycle costing and value engineering initiatives to optimise design, execution strategy
	Establish and maintain strategic cost planning frameworks aligned with PE Energy’s capital allocation, cashflow priorities, and investment approval processes


Contract and Claim Management:


	Lead change management processes, including evaluation, negotiation, approval, and formalisation of variations and compensation events.
	Support dispute resolution processes, including mediation, adjudication, and arbitration, with robust commercial and contractual input
	Perform detailed quantum analysis, including entitlement assessment, cost build-ups, and impact evaluation for claims and variations
	Administer EPC, EPCM, consultancy, and service contracts under FIDIC and bespoke PE Energy/industry specific contract forms


Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Leadership:


	Integral part of commercial team interfacing to customers, leading negotiations on pricing, KPIs, service credits, penalties/bonuses, and contract amendments.
	Collaborate closely with EPIIM team to optimize availability, lifecycle cost, and project profitability


Inter Company Billing:


	Assist in developing a framework for inter-company billing
	Ensure accuracy, transparency, allocations & reconciliations
	Liaising with internal stakeholders to ensure end to end completion of inter billing cycle
	Identify & Lead improvement initiatives.


Responsibilities


	Provide end-to-end commercial leadership across oil & gas and infrastructure projects, including marginal field development, brownfield modifications, and EPC/EPCM scopes.
	Identify new commercial opportunities, develop business cases, and secure approvals for intercompany billing.
	Advise management on commercial strategy and modelling to maximise value and manage delivery risk.
	Drive lifecycle costing and value engineering initiatives to optimise design and execution strategy.
	Lead change management processes, including evaluation, negotiation, approval, and formalisation of variations and compensation events.
	Support dispute resolution processes, including mediation, adjudication, and arbitration, with robust commercial and contractual input.
	Administer EPC, EPCM, consultancy, and service contracts under FIDIC and bespoke contract forms.
	Collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders to optimise availability, lifecycle cost, and project profitability.


Requirements
Required:


	Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, or a related discipline.
	8-10 years of experience in commercial operations, bid management, or proposal development within industrial automation, energy, or engineering services.
	Strong commercial and cost governance skills.
	Proven ability in risk management and contingency planning.
	Excellent contract strategy and administration capabilities.
	Experience in claims management and dispute resolution.
	Proficiency in procurement and commercial advisory.
	Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and communication skills.


Preferred:


	MBA or equivalent advanced degree.
	Experience with inter-company billing and cost allocation.
	Familiarity with FIDIC contract forms.


Internal Relationships:


	Finance and Accounts
	Projects
	Sales Leadership
	Legal


External Relationships:


	Consultants
	Client and stakeholders.


What We Offer


	Competitive compensation and benefits package.
	Opportunity to work on high-impact projects in the energy sector.
	Professional development and career growth opportunities.
	Collaborative and dynamic work environment.
	Health and wellbeing support.

Logistics Coordinator / Journey Manager Job at South Dredge Limited




        
    

        
        
     

            
    

South Dredge Limited is a Marine, civil and mechanical engineering contractor providing dredging, civil and mechanical services across Nigeria. We specialize in dredging and marine support services, civil construction works and manpower development. Over the years, we have helped restore our nation’s waterways, provided bespoke construction services to clients and empowered local human resources via manpower development and training. With just 10+ years experience, South dredge remains committed to continually improving its expertise and delivering quality dredging and construction services. During this time, we’ve engaged in numerous projects  with varying scopes and budget levels. South Dredge will more than just “manage” your project. Our expertise allows us to save you time, money, and limit your risk exposure.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Logistics Coordinator / Journey Manager

Job Location: Lagos

Requirements


	Primavera / MS Project / Excel, P&ID & Construction, drawing, reading, planning & Scheduling skills and experience.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Applications to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Front Office Manager Job at Hilton Worldwide




        
    

        
        Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full-service hotels and resorts to extended-stay suites and mid-priced hotels. For nearly a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travelers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands. Our vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality unites us as a team to create remarkable hospitality experiences around the world every day. And our amazing Team Members are at the heart of it all.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Front Office Manager
     

            
    



Job Identification: 224821
Job Location: Owerri, Imo
Employment Type: Full Time
Job Category: Guest Services, Operations, and Front Office

Job Description


	Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Front Office Manager, you’re not just overseeing daily front office operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.


Here's what you'll do during a typical day:


	Manage daily front office operations: Oversee Front Office activities including guest service, registration, room inventory, and adherence to policies and standards
	Monitor and elevate service: Track guest satisfaction, address service issues, and guide the team to implement improvements that enhance the guest experience
	Implement revenue initiatives: Promote hotel services and execute up-selling tactics to drive room occupancy and revenue growth
	Facilitate team knowledge: Provide regular updates and training to ensure the team is well-informed of hotel offerings, services, and local attractions
	Delight our guests: Welcome guests, respond to inquiries, and resolve concerns promptly to uphold service standards
	Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support front office team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment
